class.name: ResourceImporterDDSStreamed
class.brief_description: Imports a DDS image as a [StreamedTexture2D].
class.description: Imports a DirectDraw Surface file as a [StreamedTexture2D] rather than a plain texture. The DDS mipmap chain is written into the [code].stex[/code] file exactly as it was authored. [b]Note:[/b] only plain 2D DDS files with a mipmap chain can be streamed. Cubemaps, texture arrays and 3D textures, as well as files with no mipmaps. [b]Note:[/b] unlike [ResourceImporterDDS], this importer does not keep the original file in exported projects. Once a DDS is imported as a streamed texture, reading its original [code]res://[/code] path with [FileAccess] at run-time will fail, like other imported texture formats.

members.member: The maximum LOD (mipmap level) that can be loaded for this texture. Lower values allow higher resolution. A value of [code]0[/code] uses the global setting from [member ProjectSettings.rendering/textures/streaming/max_lod]. Values [code]1[/code] to [code]14[/code] correspond to LOD levels [code]0[/code] to [code]13[/code].

The minimum LOD (mipmap level) the texture starts at when loaded. Higher values result in lower initial resolution. A value of [code]0[/code] uses the global setting from [member ProjectSettings.rendering/textures/streaming/min_lod]. Values [code]1[/code] to [code]14[/code] correspond to LOD levels [code]0[/code] to [code]13[/code].
